tex_content.html:
\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch10:10-12Let $(M, g)$ be a Riemannian manifold. Suppose $\gamma : [a, b] \to M$ is a unitspeed geodesic segment with no interior conjugate points, $J$ is a normal Jacobi field along $\gamma $, and $V$ is any other piecewise smooth normal vector field along $\gamma $ such that $V(a) = J(a)$ and $V(b) = J(b)$.

  1. Show that $I(V, V) \geq I(J, J)$.

  2. Now assume in addition that $\gamma (b)$ is not conjugate to $\gamma (a)$ along $\gamma $. Show that $I(V, V) = I(J, J)$ if and only if $V = J$.

\end{exercise}
